listings.d: Midcoast Mobile RV Services is a locally owned RV repair and maintenance company based in Bowdoinham, Maine, whose RVSA Certified Master Technicians travel to the customer's campground, storage yard or driveway. It services Class A, B and C motorhomes, fifth wheels, travel trailers and pop-ups. Work covers maintenance and winterizing, propane system inspection and repair, air conditioning, appliance repair, water heaters and furnaces, and electrical troubleshooting. It also offers pre-purchase inspections and RV transportation, and advertises a 24/7 emergency line.

coverage_quotes: We cover Midcoast and Southern Maine — from Rockland to Newport to Rangeley, down to the New Hampshire border and all along the coastline.
Rockland Camden Belfast Augusta Brunswick Bath Portland Newport Rangeley Waterville Kennebunk Damariscotta And More
evidence.type_quote: RVSA Certified Master Technicians who come directly to you — campground, storage yard, or your driveway. No haul-in required.

listings.d: J&D RV Service, LLC is a mobile RV service located in Topsham, Maine, run by Joe Richards, a retired US Army veteran and RV technician certified by the RV Technicians Association of America. It works on most makes and models and travels throughout the State of Maine. Maintenance and repairs include water heaters, propane furnaces, roof inspection and resealing, absorption refrigerators, stuck slides and leveling systems, tire inspection and inflation, propane system leak testing, plumbing repairs, air conditioner cleaning and hydraulic systems. It is available Monday to Saturday 9 to 5 and for emergencies, and offers a discount to veterans and first responders.

coverage_quotes: We will travel throughout The State of Maine.
evidence.emergency_quote: We are available Monday - Saturday 9-5 and emergencies.

listings.d: Maine Mobile RV provides on-site service for RVs and motorhomes from small travel trailers to Class A motorhomes, whether a seasonal unit or stored at home. It performs routine maintenance, winterizations, repairs and inspections and says it is available year-round for winter service and projects, with winter service only when the unit is uncovered, accessible and powered. It serves Central, Southern and Mid coast Maine including the Lakes Region. It states it does not repair RV chassis, engine or generators, or make interior or exterior structural repairs.

listings.d: Pioneer Mobile RV Services LLC is a veteran-owned mobile RV repair business serving Southern Maine and describing itself as electrical experts. It brings RV repair to the customer's location and lets owners book a service slot online. It publishes an emergency phone number for urgent calls.

evidence.type_quote: Mobile RV Repair That Rolls to You

listings.d: Hatch RV Service & Repair is a family-owned mobile RV service and shop run by Troy Hatch, a certified RV technician trained at the National RV Training Academy. It offers general and seasonal maintenance, pre- and post-trip audits, owner education, system repairs and upgrades, fresh- and waste-water system care, and exterior audits and repairs. Its mobile service is primarily offered in Central Maine from May to October and in Clermont, Florida from December to March, and it also travels the continental United States. The Maine shop is at 720 River Road, Chelsea and is open May through October by appointment.
listings.spec: Open May thru October by appointment.

coverage_quotes: Our Mobile Service is primarily offered in Central Maine (May-October) and Clermont, Florida and surrounding areas within a 35 Mi radius (December-March).
evidence.type_quote: Hatch RV Service & Repair is a Mobile RV Service that is here to help you get back on the road to adventure and make every moment count.

listings.d: Acadia Mobile RV Services offers on-site mobile RV repair based out of Bar Harbor, Maine and Acadia National Park. Its technician Chris trained at the National RV Training Academy and earned an RV Repair Technician Certificate. Services include electrical troubleshooting and repair of 12V DC and 120V AC systems, winterization and de-winterization, and A/C cleaning and optimization, along with plumbing, slide-outs and appliance repairs. Its Bar Harbor season runs May 2026 to October 2026, and it is near Hartsville, South Carolina until mid-April 2026.

listings.d: Mobile RV, motorhome and camper repair run by certified RV service technician Erik Boucher out of Portland.
